protocol.cast: 32 physical coin tosses H/T; working seed SHA-256(working id + ':' + toss string)

diagnostic_D1.statistic: mean Jaccard overlap of canonical/null dealt fragment text sets

protocol.null: N1 degree-matched typed rewiring, fresh instance per working/control
protocol.parent: M1.1 canonical Android version of record, commit 6ca681e...

positive_control.role: instrument sensitivity only; not evidence of contact
positive_control.signal: one preregistered concrete signal word from target added as a dealt fragment
positive_control.target: chosen before composition by fixed sealed control randomization

primary.P1: one-sided exact target-draw randomization, canonical rank sum
primary.P2: one-sided exact target-draw randomization, sum(null rank - canonical rank)

protocol.question: what is the scene that will be shown at the close of this working?

reader.composer: fresh language-model composition; every dealt fragment verbatim; grammar/connectives only
reader.repeat: repeated visits cycle through that zone's registered fragments in order
reader.rule: one fragment per recorded passage, destination zone only; preserve passage order

protocol.stop_rule: If v2 fails D1, D2, or the >=10/20 positive-control gate, no working begins; the language-mediated reader is retired and a direct Numogram-as-reader assay requires separate registration.

working_target.draw: OS entropy only after both arm readings and rankings are sealed
working_target.generator: deterministic frozen target generator in this source
